info.title: Callin Public API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the public endpoints mounted under /public.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ISO timestamp for created_at sort, or name string for name sort

parameters.name: startBeforeUnix
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds

parameters.name: startAfterUnix
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds

get.description: Returns campaigns for the API key account. Contacts are omitted; use the campaign detail route for the contact list.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on the campaign name.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: createdAt of the last campaign from the previous page.

post.description: Saves a campaign for a callin or elevenlabs agent that already has a phone number. Set launch to dial immediately, or scheduled with a future window. Omit both to save a draft. Extra contact fields are passed to the agent as dynamic variables. Follow-up calls run for ElevenLabs agents when a call fails as busy or no-answer.

patch.description: Rejected while the campaign is running. Changing contacts, the agent, or the schedule replaces a waiting job.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the campaign and removes a waiting job. A running campaign must be stopped first.

post.description: Dials contacts from startIndex, or from the saved resume index when a scheduled job is replaced. Requires an active subscription with minutes remaining.
Queues dialing at startTime in the given IANA timezone, and pauses until the next day's startTime after endTime. A paused or stopped campaign resumes from its saved contact index.
Removes a waiting or paused job immediately. A running job stops before the next contact.

200.description: Campaign stopped, or stopping if a call loop is in progress

get.description: Returns contacts saved on the API key account. Use contactId values with POST /public/v1/campaigns.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches phone number, name, or email.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: createdAt of the last contact from the previous page.

post.description: Stores one contact. Phone numbers are saved without spaces or punctuation. A duplicate phone number returns 409. Extra fields are kept and can be used as campaign dynamic variables.

Creates up to 2000 contacts. Numbers already on the account are skipped. Duplicate numbers in the same request keep the last row. The created contactId values can be passed to a campaign as contactIds.
Deletes the given contacts owned by the API key account. Unknown ids are ignored.

patch.description: Merges the sent fields into the contact. Omitted fields are left as they are.

followUpIntervals.description: Delay in minutes before each follow-up. One value per attempt.
